title: Unirationality of the complex moduli space of double covers of genus-five curves branched at four points
source_title: (Uni)rational parametrizations of $\mathcal{R}_{g,2}$, $\mathcal{R}_{g,4}$ and $\mathcal{R}_{g,6}$ in low genera
author: Andreas Leopold Knutsen; Margherita Lelli-Chiesa; Alessandro Verra
difficulty_reason: The standard Nikulin/K3 and quadric facts do not identify a dominant rational parameter space for the genus21 marked surface family. The authors reconstruct the three-quadric net from an elliptic pencil and bisecants, force its fourth exceptional curve, and then use an irreducible rational pencil member to produce the rational parameterization. Their explicit boundary deformation interchanges the two distinguished lattice classes and closes marked-cover irreducibility, supplying the new geometric obligation beyond the cited surface and compactification foundations.

historical_source_pdf_evidence.original_difficulty_reason: The authors reconstruct genus21 non-standard Nikulin surfaces from nets of quadrics through elliptic/rational normal curves and bisecant lines, then identify the generic Prym-cover fiber and establish irreducibility of the marked lattice cover by explicit boundary deformations. This birational parametrization exceeds qualifying-exam moduli theory.
